name: Purple cushion fleabane
desc: Purple cushion fleabane (Erigeron poliospermus): a plant that turns sunlight into food. Recorded 17 times near the park in GBIF.
about: Erigeron poliospermus is a species of flowering plant in the family Asteraceae known by the common names gray-seeded fleabane, purple cushion fleabane, and hairy-seed fleabane.
